prompt: Top 5 football teams that won the most number of UCL titles

4. **Bayern Munich (6 titles)**: Bayern Munich has won the UEFA Champions League six times, with their most recent victory coming in the 2019-20 season. They have also won the European Cup once before the Champions League era.
